subject.title: fix(workboard): preserve proof history across later card writes

question: Should the Workboard contract preserve source compatibility by making proof-page metadata optional/additive for existing list consumers, or intentionally introduce a breaking required-field contract?
rationale: The runtime field is additive, but the exported TypeScript contract changes a previously constructible list-card shape into one requiring a new property; choosing a permanent public API direction needs owner intent.

options.title: Keep `proofPage` additive
options.body: Require Gateway-produced views to include the field at runtime while making the shared public list/card shape accept older consumers without it.

options.title: Accept a breaking contract
options.body: Keep `proofPage` required and document a deliberate major-version migration for all typed Workboard API consumers.

recommendation.title: Keep `proofPage` additive
recommendation.body: Require Gateway-produced views to include the field at runtime while making the shared public list/card shape accept older consumers without it.

likelyOwner.reason: The linked merged proof-lifecycle work is the closest available ownership history for the affected Workboard proof contract.
